messages:
Mira Patel: alert — Sentry ingestion drop observed from 2026-03-15T11:04Z. Error counts collapsed across services. Noticed at 11:04:56Z. :rotating_light:
IncidentBot: Pager opened -> #incidents, priority: P1. Incident ref: INC-20260315-171
SRE Oncall: acknowledged. Mira, any recent config/deploys?
Mira Patel: no code deploys. Traces show exceptions still thrown locally, but Sentry event rate is near zero starting 11:04. Internal logs show outbound responses from our edge to sentry.io are 503/429.
Alex Chen: reproducer to Sentry ingestion (sanitized):

```
curl -i -H "X-Sentry-Auth: Sentry sentry_version=7" -d @evt.json https://sentry.io/api/999/store/
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
Retry-After: 15
x-sentry-error: upstream ingestion overloaded
```

Alex Chen: also intermittent 429s with Retry-After. Looks like vendor ingestion throttling/backlog.
Tony Ruiz: SDKs on web are losing events after retry caps. Mobile SDKs persist longer but may still fail to ship.
Irene Kim: Impact summary: delayed or missing error telemetry, which impedes paging and triage. No direct user-facing downtime, but elevated risk for missed regressions. Estimate: large fraction of events unpersisted during window.
SRE Oncall: do we have a fallback DSN we can flip to (internal)? Any chance to re-route?
Mira Patel: we have an internal alt DSN (sentry-fallback) used for experiments. Swapping requires a config change in our gateway and a soft restart. Low risk, minimal infra touches. We can also enable extended SDK buffering via a feature flag.
Alex Chen: mitigation plan options:
- quick flip to sentry-fallback DSN at gateway layer (recommended)
- enable SDK extended retries/persistence (best-effort)
- capture events to internal logging/warehouse for replay (BigQuery)
Which do we prioritize?
SRE Oncall: flip DSN first for rapid recovery, enable buffering in parallel, and start archiving raw events to internal sink. Tony, coordinate SDK flags. Alex, prep config and test.
deploy-bot: starting deployment: config-change/sentry-dsn-switch -> edge-gateway-A (id: dpl-9981)
Alex Chen: canarying switch on edge-gateway-A now. Test request to sentry-fallback returned 200 and x-event-id on first attempt.

```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
x-event-id: 4b9d1f
```

Alex Chen: rolling to remaining gateways. Expected completion ~7m.
Tony Ruiz: toggling SDK persistence TTL to 15m for mobile and enabling local store for web via feature flag rollout. Web retry behavior still risky — some events may already be dropped.
Irene Kim: I've opened a vendor ticket with Sentry support: "Service ingest returns 503/429 causing high event loss". Ticket SNT-2042 created; support acknowledged and escalated to ingestion team.
Mira Patel: support teams — add note to active customer cases about delayed observability and triage lag.
Support Ops: noted. We'll add a standard template note and pause escalations until we verify captures.
SRE Oncall: all gateways on sentry-fallback. Event counts resumed to ~78% of baseline and climbing. Watch for dupes due to SDK retries + queued flushes.
Alex Chen: enabling dedupe by event_id in our pipeline for next 48h to prevent alert storms. Also archiving raw queued payloads for potential replay.
Irene Kim: vendor update: Sentry reports ingestion autoscaler misfired causing backlog and temporary 503 responses. They are applying fixes and validating backlog retention. No firm ETA yet. They've asked for sample event IDs we sent; attaching logs.
Mira Patel: estimate lost vs recovered: preliminary window 11:04:56Z-11:34:00Z. We attempted ~1.8M events; persisted ~600k -> rough lost ~1.2M. Will refine once we reconcile archives with vendor.
SRE Oncall: Handoff planned. I'm handing to Tony Ruiz at 11:45Z. Primary follow-ups: monitor vendor ticket, verify full parity with baseline, run dedupe job, confirm support messaging.
Tony Ruiz: handoff accepted. I'll own until next oncall. Running checklist: confirm no downstream regressions, kick off dedupe job, audit SDK replay rates, prepare customer-facing summary if retention fails.
IncidentBot: INC-20260315-171 status -> mitigated (fallback active). Post-incident review scheduled.
Mira Patel: please add the DSN flip + SDK buffer toggles to our incident runbook as a rapid mitigation. We'll wait for vendor RFO and then do a postmortem to decide long-term changes. Thanks all for quick coordination. :heart:
Support Ops: We'll follow up with customers whose cases relied on Sentry evidence and update after vendor confirms backlog recovery.
Alex Chen: saving full logs and payload archives to internal retention (48h) for replay if vendor can't recover backlog.
Irene Kim: vendor update: ingestion team fixed autoscaler and is replaying backlog; they will confirm how many events persisted.
Mira Patel: closing paging loop for now. If vendor can't recover backlog, we'll assess replay and notify impacted customers.
